summary.name: Pixelmator Pro
summary.one_liner: Pixelmator Pro is an image editor for Mac and iPad that offers professional editing tools and AI features.
use_cases: using AI tools for image editing
editing images on iPad with touch
basic cropping and color adjustment on iOS
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Pixelmator Pro as a Mac and iPad image editor with professional tools and AI features. Its iPad version includes nondestructive editing, AI features, and tools for freely transforming layers, optimized for touch. Pixelmator Pro for iPad is included with an Apple Creator Studio subscription alongside the Mac version and other pro apps such as Final Cut Pro and Logic Pro. The page also mentions Pixelmator Classic for iOS, a separate 2014 app with basic cropping, color adjustments, and effects, which is no longer updated.
notable: Nondestructive editing and free transform of layers
Available with Apple Creator Studio subscription
caveats: Pixelmator Pro for iPad requires an Apple Creator Studio subscription
Pixelmator Classic for iOS is no longer updated and its Mac counterpart is discontinued
